question: On which of the following occasions is 'Natyanjali Utsav' celebrated in Tamil Nadu every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahashivratri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Natyanjali Utsav is celebrated in Tamil Nadu every year on the occasion of Mahashivratri.**
 
• The festival is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is celebrated in the temple town of Chidambaram.
 
• The festival is a tribute to Lord Nataraja, who is considered the lord of danc
